## 💡 Describe the Feature

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to suggest.

## 🎯 Motivation

Explain why this feature would be useful. What problem does it solve?

Describe how you envision this feature working.

**Example Usage:**
```bash
npm run cli -- your-new-command --option value
```

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered alternative approaches? Describe them.

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or examples here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] This feature doesn't duplicate existing functionality

- [ ] This aligns with VEXE's purpose and scope
